result.title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
result.comment: 63 pages, 10 figures. Code and data availability statements are included in the manuscript
result.summary: Discovering continuous symmetries directly from differential-equation data can reveal geometric structure for model reduction and scientific machine learning without symbolic determining equations or a closed-form representation of the governing system. We formulate intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem on sampled jet-space data. Admissible generators are identified from a sampled determining operator and separated from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions. The framework combines prolongation, sequential subspace restrictions, and a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients. A rank-stabilization preflight test diagnoses systems whose represented intrinsic symmetry algebra does not stabilize under dictionary refinement. On a controlled differential-equation benchmark with an analytically known 11-dimensional represented intrinsic symmetry algebra, the method recovers the complete represented generator set, reproduces its Lie-bracket structure to numerical precision, and approximates a known generator beyond the training domain. Here we show that explicit intrinsic continuous-symmetry generators can be recovered from data obtained from exact or approximate differential systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将从微分方程数据中直接发现内在 Lie 点对称生成元表述为采样射流空间上的算子学习问题，用延拓、子空间序列约束与固定非线性字典辨识生成元，并区分冗余、依赖解与几何平凡方向；附秩稳定预检，在已知 11 维对称代数基准上恢复生成元并复现 Lie 括号结构。
AI.relevance_reason: 其从数据辨识生成元、剔除冗余与平凡方向并检验代数结构稳定的思路，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 状态哪些方向真正承载不变的任务信息、哪些只是表示冗余提供可供核查的诊断工具，但领域距离较远。
